text:
Tessa R: Quick one New hire Omar (remote CA) starts Mon. Checkr flagged SSN mismatch. He says he mailed SSA confirmation letter yesterday. Can we still do I-9 day-1 if vendor hasn't cleared?
Marta V: If Checkr is pending we can still do I-9 Section 1 + authorize rep for Section 2. But Security wants Checkr cleared before final badge activation. We can issue a temporary login though.
Ethan Q: I can be the authorized rep on Monday 9:30AM. I'll inspect originals and sign Section 2. If Checkr comes back later we update access flags.
Luis P: Ops note: if laptop ships, mark "hold until ID verified" and add signature required. IT can ship overnight. Also confirm shipping address matches payroll docs.
Tessa R: Omar is on a temporary address (staying with family). He sent a PDF of SSA letter and a utility bill. I uploaded both to the Checkr ticket.
OnboardBot: Reminder: please upload signed "Authorized Rep" form after inspection. Template: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/forms/rep-form.pdf
Marta V: Legal reminder: rep must also write company name and role on the form. We'll store the signed scan in /secure/hr/onboarding/.
Ethan Q: I'll do the inspection and take a scanned copy. Can someone add me to the calendar invite and include the candidate phone?
Tessa R: Done 10:30 invite sent to Omar with Ethan & Marta. Phone in invite. Also pinged payroll about SSA letter so taxes won't block first paycheck.
Luis P: Shipping updated: laptop scheduled to ship Sun pm with "Hold for ID" tag. Ops will release when scan is uploaded. Tracker: IT-1234.
Tessa R: Payroll also asked Omar to finish W-4 + direct deposit. I sent him the links and an SMS nudge.
OnboardBot: Onboarding checklist status: I-9: pending rep, Checkr: under review, W-4: sent, Direct deposit: pending. Auto-followup set 24h before start.
Marta V: Small compliance note: if the rep is not Redwood staff (e.g., friend), avoid it. Ethan is fine since he's Redwood. Please ensure rep signs their printed name and date.
Ethan Q: Confirmed. I'll upload the signed Section 2 scan to the secure folder within 2 hours of the meeting.
Tessa R: One more Omar asked whether Day 1 orientation is virtual or in-person for remote new hires. We usually do a 90m Zoom intro + badge pick if local. For remote, we'll do Zoom and ship badge later.
Luis P: Ops can mail a physical badge if candidate wants. Default: virtual orientation + digital badge link for SSO. Physical badge shipped after ID verified.
Tessa R: Great. I'll close loop once Checkr clears and after Ethan uploads the Section 2 scan. Thanks all.
OnboardBot: Checkr ticket created #CHK-7538 assigned to Tessa R. Auto-reminder: 48h before start.
Tessa R: Update 13:00: Checkr marked "review required" then cleared at 16:10 after SSA letter. Ethan did the rep inspection at 9:30 and uploaded Section 2 scan. Laptop released and shipped. W-4 + Direct deposit completed by Omar. Closing thread 389
